notes.title: Playtest 2 is live!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="WH81PHmQAPs;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Join summer playtest now![/h3][p]The botanist has been hard at work since the last time raising new challenges and unleashing cunning new enemies to ensure your utter failure.[/p][p][/p][p]Do you think you have what it takes to defeat him ?

Here a are the new main features of this playtest:
[/p][h3]The Map[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454210/456a8e5b1e3aa8bc4d58b2082eb0d253895ecc91.png"][/img][/p][p]Explore the Rissacca Archipelago, to gather resources and blessings. Choose your path and difficulty toward your salvation.[/p][p][/p][h3]New enemies[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454210/aa80ac669742d7d5434d52421de5dda8d88f92dc.png"][/img][/p][p]Crunchy undead, pesky crabs and the fearsome Corrupter are for your pleasure and pain.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Merchant[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454210/bac3239efd1479883c92262e14296570c919b6fa.png"][/img][/p][p]This odd character has a lot to offer, this is a must seen location.[/p][p]***** Highly recommend.[/p][p]-Lady Gertrude[/p][p][/p][h3]Traps![/h3][p]Watch your steps...[/p][p][/p][p]Our commitment to get players feedback to bring [b]IoK[/b] to the next level is stronger than ever. 
Please enjoy this build and share your thoughts with us!
Thank you for your continuing support.[/p][p]
Long live the Corvus!

Official website: [url="https://islesofkrom.com/"]https://islesofkrom.com/[/url][/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/TnAnWGm5"]https://discord.gg/TnAnWGm5[/url][/p]
